name: html-deck-scripts
description: Dependency manifest for deck_qa.mjs. Install it beside the deck, not here: copy this file into the deck's directory and run `npm install`, or just `npm install playwright` there. deck_qa.mjs resolves playwright from the working directory. Installing into this skill directory puts playwright-core's own SKILL.md files inside the skill, and recursive skill scanners register them as extra skills.
